verdict_scope: Isolated design/evidence audit of commit cf087de; not production/release authorization

manifest_binding.freshness: All tracked source/dependency/evidence hashes match both current worktree and immutable cf087de blobs; external hashed inputs also match. The later review bundle is bound to immutable commit cf087de.

findings.title: 84x14 learning table and 672 new-pair reasons reproduce exactly
evidence: learning-matrix.csv has 84 rows and exactly 14 machine decision columns, yielding 1176 decisions; all 1176 reason fields are nonempty.
pairwise-eligibility.json has exactly 672 form/new-machine records, each with a reason; its boolean and reason values match the final CSV exactly.

Primary coverage is breakthrough=30, counter=19, suppression=20, rally=15 (sum 84). New machine coverage is breach_lunge=30, guardian_riposte=19, arc_lock=20, rally_signal=15, expose_weakness=26, standburst=12, field_triage=11, tempo_break=10.
Old teaching counts remain cut=41, surf=18, rest=84, guard=84, sunny_day=17, rain_dance=23.
findings.repair_or_narrow_check: No repair for the audited design archive. For any future design edit, rerun the probe and require CSV/pairwise exact equality plus these counts.

findings.title: 47 evolution edges and 24 incompatibilities are internally derived, not only asserted
evidence: evolution-inheritance.json contains 47 unique edges.
Recomputing new-machine current-form-eligible but target-ineligible pairs from those edges and the final matrix yields exactly 24.
The derived set equals evolution-incompatibilities.csv exactly; machine split is breach_lunge=10, rally_signal=8, field_triage=4, guardian_riposte=1, arc_lock=1.
findings.repair_or_narrow_check: Future evolution-rule edits must rerun this derivation and preserve preview/return-on-commit as unimplemented until a real transaction exists.

findings.title: 42 old and 14 new focused tests have real stored output and still pass
evidence: preparation-checks.json stores four commands and stderr outputs: 19+9+8+6=42, all exit 0.
tests-final.log stores 14 test names and OK.
Fresh rerun at cf087de: 14 prototype, 19 device-controls, 9 technique-inventory, 8 tactical-device, and 6 evolution-device tests all exited 0.
54 preparation input hashes are unchanged before/after and both user bank hashes match expected.
findings.repair_or_narrow_check: These support scripted PC status only. Human three-key, real-device, and future production integration remain outside this evidence.

findings.title: 4800-battle league configuration, seeds, event hashes, controls, and statistics reconcile
evidence: league.json.gz records tactics_v5, 2 candidates, 4 opponents, 3 arms, seeds 2026100590000..2026100590099, and 2400 primary battles; every arm has the exact 100 seed sequence and each of the 2400 primary records carries a SHA-256 event hash.
The declared 4800 total equals 2400 primary plus 2400 controls: 23*100 side-swap checks and 100 self-identity checks. Failure lists are empty and source/bank hashes are stable.
All winners are binary. All 8 score rows and both exact paired McNemar comparisons per row recompute exactly.

Independent first-seed replay of all 24 candidate/opponent/arm combinations matched stored complete-event SHA and winner. Independent replay of the 23 first-seed swap controls and 1 self-identity control passed.
findings.repair_or_narrow_check: A full independent 2400 replay is possible but unnecessary for this audit. For a new source/config/seed, replay at least all first seeds plus targeted changed matchups before reusing conclusions.

findings.title: Fixed-league strength/fairness conclusions remain bounded
evidence: Counter vs dive is on/off 28 positive/5 negative, exact p=0.0000661877; on vs old rest is 23/9, p=0.0200616. Mirror, garden, and battery results do not support a general counter claim.
All tempo effect-vs-off and on-vs-alternative tests have p>0.05; despite 460/1520 energy loss in the cited matchups, net wins are -3/+2.
The 100 primary seeds are reused across all matchups, swaps are controls rather than additional independent seeds, and no multiple-comparison correction is applied.
findings.risk: No whole-pool, acquisition-rate, production-opportunity-cost, or complete-run fairness conclusion is established.
findings.repair_or_narrow_check: Keep the report wording fixed-squad/exploratory. A future claim requires preregistered full-pool acquisition/complete-run experiments and an explicit multiplicity policy.

findings.title: Animation evidence is real but acceptance-adapter only; shared budget remains unproven
evidence: visual.json has 10 scenes, 37 outputs, and 7 passing checks. All 37 output byte sizes/hashes match files; final published outputs are byte-identical to the replay output.
All 10 authoritative scene event hashes were independently regenerated from the frozen isolated prototype; positive/negative teaching event counts match their scenes.
Teaching overlay peaks are counter=42 and tempo=36; each is only a constant teaching-overlay estimate checked against 192.

The metadata explicitly says production_renderer_consumes_teaching_effect=false and native/weather/teaching shared total budget is not implemented or verified. The prior scheduling failure and raw events are preserved in visual.failure-scheduling.json.
findings.risk: This does not verify production timeline ordering, production renderer integration, native+weather+teaching shared draw budget, ESP32 limits, or independent art.
findings.repair_or_narrow_check: A production claim requires real integration plus measured native/weather/teaching totals and device timing; the current 42/36 values must stay named teaching-overlay estimates.

findings.title: Unimplemented production and review gaps are disclosed rather than misrepresented
evidence: build-checks.json marks production_and_new_machine_learning_integration=false. Between baseline and cf087de, all 82 claimed production/runtime files are unchanged; only four isolated acceptance/test files plus docs/evidence were added.
New first-batch IDs appear in isolated tools/tests/design evidence, not production sim/data/device/save/renderer paths; tactics_v6/hex implementation is absent.
qualitygate-final.json has local gate/raw_gate pass but agent_action.task_complete=false, no effective semantic rules, no independent semantic lanes, and mutation not applicable/executed.
independent-review.json records three 429 failures and no final independent verdict; main-agent-self-review is explicitly non-independent.
findings.risk: Local QG and main-agent self-review cannot authorize production or substitute for central semantic/final independent review.
findings.repair_or_narrow_check: Before production integration, obtain a current-fingerprint central semantic result and a fresh independent code/release review after service recovery. Preserve current failures; do not rewrite them into passes.

claim_audit.reports/teaching-design-2026-10-05.md: Supported for design counts and explicitly excludes balance, real UI, device, and full production acceptance.
claim_audit.reports/teaching-prototype-2026-10-05.md: Supported within isolated design/prototype/visual evidence boundaries; its fixed-squad, seed-reuse, missing shared-budget, and missing independent-review disclosures match raw evidence.
claim_audit.docs/30-skill-machines-and-learning.md: Design and eligibility claims are supported. Strength/fairness language is bounded by its unbalanced status, section 4.2 no-strength-conclusion statement, and complete-run fairness requirement.
claim_audit.docs/31-prebattle-preparation-flow.md: Existing 42-test support is real but script-only; hex, reward-to-learning improvements, real-human timing, and production extensions are clearly proposal/unimplemented.
claim_audit.docs/32-teaching-skill-animation-contrac: Ten-scene isolated visual evidence supports the stated adapter coverage, but the document correctly limits production rendering, ESP32, old-teaching fixes, and shared budget.

limitations: This is an evidence audit, not an independent code-correctness/release review.
No images were opened or emitted; binary visual outputs were only listed/hash-compared.
The full 4800 battles were not blindly rerun; all statistics were recomputed from raw JSON and 24 primary replays plus all first-seed symmetry controls were independently regenerated.
Central semantic/final independent review remains unavailable, so pass_with_risk applies only to evidence completeness and bounded claims.
next_steps: Keep this change classified as isolated design/prototype only.
Before production: integrate through real learning/reward/save/UI/renderer paths and obtain central semantic plus fresh independent review.
Before animation release: measure the combined native/weather/teaching budget on the target runtime rather than reusing 42/36 estimates.
Before balance/fairness claims: run preregistered full-pool acquisition/complete-run experiments with distinct or explicitly modeled seed reuse and multiplicity control.
